value.rationale: Exact first-projection orthogonality provides a structural explanation for a natural and initially counterintuitive phenomenon: negative finite cross-covariance but asymptotically independent nondegenerate Gaussian crossing/nesting fluctuations. It settles simultaneous inference for the two natural random-matching pair statistics and cannot be inferred from equal marginals or from their separate CLTs.
